name: com.ricardosodre.fmu
description: Import Figma Motion animations as native Unity UI (real hierarchy + AnimationClip), not a rendered video. Includes a ScriptedImporter for .fmu files, a resolution-independent SDF shape shader, and a runtime player.

samples.description: Voice/listening indicator: pulsing ring + three equalizer bars.
Listening indicator variant with spring easing, scale and animated fill color.
Rotation (arc/ring), width, translation-X, squash & stretch, and hold/step easing.
